templates.heading: New document
templates.subheading: Start from a template, or from a blank page
templates.generateBody: Point AI at a repository and let it draft the document
templates.customiseTitle: Save an editable copy to this workspace
templates.retireTitle: Retire — stops offering it, keeps the row

emptyState.prompt: Start writing, or pick a template:
emptyState.failed: That template could not be loaded. Your document is untouched.

editor.markdownWarning: In Markdown, the {count, plural, one {# commented passage appears} other {# commented passages appear}} as raw HTML. Editing or deleting that markup unpins the thread from the text — the comment itself is kept either way, with the passage it was written about.

comments.empty: Select text and use the comment button to start a thread here.

provenance.behindOne: The code behind this page has changed since it was written.
provenance.behindMany: {count} of the linked paths have changed since this page was written.
provenance.willPropose: An update will be proposed for review.
provenance.syncModeProposeHint: Queue an update for review. The safe default.
provenance.syncModeAutoHint: Apply updates without asking. A full rewrite still asks, so hand-written prose is never overwritten unseen.
provenance.syncModeOffHint: Stop watching this path, including the behind-the-code badge.
provenance.syncModeFailed: Could not change the sync setting

diff.noWordingChanged: No wording changed — the update only touched formatting.
diff.unchangedBlocks: {count, plural, one {# unchanged block} other {# unchanged blocks}}
diff.tooLarge: This document is too long to diff here — use the section summary, or open the document to compare.

review.heading: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} waiting for review
review.emptyBody: When code changes under a document, the update it needs will show up here for review.
review.approved: Approved {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}}
review.staleOne: One of these was written against an older version of its page.
review.staleMany: {count} of these were written against older versions of their pages.
review.staleHint: Open them individually to see what would be overwritten.

sources.code_change_syncBlurb: Source these pages describe has moved on since they were written.
sources.regenerateBlurb: Someone asked for these to be rewritten from the source.
sources.suggest_improvementsBlurb: Edits proposed against the prose itself, not the code.

improvements.heading: Improve this document
improvements.intro: An AI reads the page and reports what is unclear, incomplete or missing. This costs one model call.
improvements.missingSections: Sections it expected and did not find
improvements.appliesAsProposal: Applying queues a rewrite for review. Your document is not changed until somebody approves it.

mergedChanges.heading: Recently merged
mergedChanges.subheading: Changes that landed. The best time to write about one is now, while somebody still has it in their head.
mergedChanges.noDocsForRepositoryHint: No document in this workspace is linked to anything in this repository.
